differences.title: 1. INITIAL LOAD
differences.leftDesc: HTML sent, no JS needed initially.
differences.rightDesc: JS must download and execute first.

differences.title: 2. DATA FETCHING
differences.leftDesc: Directly fetch from DB/APIs on server.
differences.rightDesc: Fetch using browser APIs like fetch.

differences.title: 3. SEO
differences.leftDesc: Content is readily available for crawlers.
differences.rightDesc: Relies on JS execution for crawlers.

differences.title: 4. INTERACTIVITY
differences.leftDesc: Less direct DOM manipulation. Needs hydration.

differences.title: 5. CODE EXECUTION
differences.leftDesc: Runs only on the server environment.
differences.rightDesc: Runs in the user's web browser.

differences.title: 7. BUNDLE SIZE
differences.leftDesc: No client-side JS shipped for these components.
differences.rightDesc: JS must be sent to the browser.
